_comment: What the scanner sweeps. Built from Craig's own buying history rather than
guessed: Josh Allen (27 cards, $1,914), Tom Brady (24), Drake Maye (15),
Roman Anthony (8), in Chrome / Prizm / Optic — the sets he already buys most.
Every target here is a BASE parallel: Silver Prizm, base Refractor, Rated
Rookie. That is deliberate and it is the opposite of what he normally buys.
Grading economics need a deep graded population to comp a PSA 10 against, and
a Camo 10/25 has none. Numbered parallels do not belong on this list however
must / must_not filter eBay's results, because its relevance ranking will
happily return a Gold Prizm for a Silver Prizm search. label is what gets
matched against gem-rates.json — keep it to the words that identify the SET,
since gem rate is a property of how a set was printed, not of the player.
CARD NUMBERS ARE UNVERIFIED. They are the scanner's search text, not a
lookup key, so a wrong one costs relevance rather than correctness — but
check them against a real listing before trusting a thin result.
